race.comment: DEADLY FORCE (2) resumed with a narrow maiden win at Mornington, scoring by a neck as the $1.75 favourite. He was also sent around a very short quote on debut on heavy ground in June so the market clearly has a strong opinion of him and he's expected to take a big leap forward here. LES BRAVES (1) was a nice winner fresh here then just battled at Pakenham. He can bounce back. HOOK 'N' SPUR (3) resumes. He's won first up in the past and has measured up in better races than this. Will take holding out. LUCKY SINGLE (8) resumes for her second preparation with solid claims, she ran well in town before a spell.
